text:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock the approach for Dedicated burst lanes/SLA tradeoffs for the next roadmap slice. Customers keep asking for predictable tail latency during spikes. Proposal: three lanes (reserved, burst-pocket, best-effort) + configurable eviction ordering. Thoughts?

ajay: Can you sketch the eviction ordering and how it maps to current allocator?

maria: Sure — high level: reserved (no eviction), burst-pocket (evict from burst after Xs idle or when headroom < Y%), best-effort (preemptible). Eviction triggers: capacity pressure OR SLA breach predicted.

derek: Preemption hooks need to play nice with KV cache. If we evict a session mid-chat we should surface graceful fallback — not a hard 500.

katie: From product POV we care about two OKRs: 99th latency under 500ms for reserved lanes, and cost delta < 25% vs baseline after enabling burst. Need metrics defined.

olivia_csm: A few customers asked for guaranteed minimum throughput during burst (they want a floor for X qps). They won't accept 'best effort' for certain tenants.

ajay: Implementation notes: prefer soft-preempt (SIGTER-like) + drained-connection window (30s) so KV cache can flush. We can expose policy knobs: drain_window, preempt_threshold, eviction_priority. Example config suggestion:
```json
{"lane": "burst-pocket", "drain_window_s": 30, "preempt_threshold_pct": 85, "eviction_priority": ["best-effort", "burst-pocket"]}
```

derek: +1 on drain window. Also need a migration plan for sessions > 64k tokens — those should be marked "sticky" unless customer opts in to eviction.

maria: Good call. For roadmap scope I'm proposing: prototype lane routing + drain window + simple eviction UI in Console for Q3; SLA promises only for reserved lanes in initial launch. Then in Q4 test scalable burst floors for paying customers.

katie: Can we make the SLA language explicit in product: "Reserved lanes: 99.9% uptime, 99th latency < 500ms under committed qps; Burst pockets: best-effort with SLO of degraded latency notification". That will help sales.

olivia_csm: Customers will push for a formal SLA doc. Suggest we create an "SLA addendum" template for Dedicated customers who want burst floors — call it "Burst Commitment".

ajay: Technical risk: if we allow burst floors we need cross-region capacity routing and quota controls; otherwise one noisy tenant can hog physical GPUs. That likely needs autoscale changes and routing policy work.

maria: Risk logged. Prioritization options: A) Minimal (reserved + simple burst pockets, no floors) — lowest effort. B) Hybrid (reserved + burst pockets + opt-in burst floors for select customers) — medium effort. C) Full (burst floors built-in + cross-region routing + SLA docs) — high effort.

derek: Suggest starting with B as experiment with 2 customers. We can instrument and measure real-world tail behavior before committing to C.

katie: Agree. For OKRs, add an experiment metric: "latency degradation delta for non-reserved tenants during customer bursts". Owner?

maria: Owner for experiment: @ajay (eng lead) and @olivia_csm (customer pilot). Target: prototype + 2 pilots by end of quarter (date: 2024-09-30).

ajay: I'll set up a small dedicated pool + routing rule and enable drain_window. Will post simulation results here by EOD Wednesday.

autoscale-bot: simulation job #482 completed. Summary: 2x synthetic burst against a pool of 8 GPUs -> tail latency increased 3.6x for best-effort tenants; reserved lanes unaffected. Logs: `/simulations/482/logs`

derek: Can we add a graceful fallback path so apps get a 429 with Retry-After instead of 500? That will make customers happier.

ajay: Yup — plan is to emit 429 + structured JSON with `retry_eta` and `fallback_model` fields. Example response snippet:```json
{"status": 429, "retry_eta_s": 12, "fallback_model": "gpt-small-quant"}```

maria: Good. Action items: 1) Ajay — prototype lane config + drain window (ETA: 2024-08-15). 2) Olivia — recruit 2 pilot customers and draft "Burst Commitment" template (ETA: 2024-08-22). 3) Katie — add experiment metric to OKRs and update sales collateral (ETA: 2024-08-10). 4) Derek — define session stickiness policy for >64k tokens (ETA: 2024-08-08).

katie: +1, I'll flag in the OKR doc and tag sales ops. :thumbsup:

autoscale-bot: created ticket INF-1724 (prototype lane config).

maria: Thanks all — we'll reconvene next Tuesday to review initial telemetry. If anyone hits blockers, post here. :rocket:
